rca of the issue: Original bug: header nav had `hidden md:flex` causing both Catalogue and Admin links to disappear below 768px. Fix applied by main agent: replaced with `flex items-center gap-4 sm:gap-8 shrink-0` so nav is always flex-visible, with smaller gap on mobile (gap-4=16px) and larger on sm+ (gap-8=32px). Logo also given `shrink-0` and responsive `h-10 sm:h-12 md:h-14` to prevent overflow. 'Since 1951' text block kept `hidden sm:block` to save horizontal space on very small screens. Verified: no horizontal overflow at 360px and 390px, both nav links fully within viewport.
